mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 3.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 2000) and consumer credit demand (RSAFS < 340000) signal a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST < 2000 and RSAFS < 340000 fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO < 115.0) reduces production capacity and increases input costs, compressing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 115.0, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO < 115.0 signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 2000) signals robust consumer spending and business investment, boosting corporate earnings growth expectations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-housing-starts periods (HOUST > 2000) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals an inflationary environment that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL threshold signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 133000) signals a labor market recovery that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 133000, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS > 133000 signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) signal an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 3.5% fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
